title: WPT model recipe (data/recipes/models/<name>.json): everything that changes the resulting model

data.description: what the model trains on: a dataset of a depot, whose corpus `wpt depot build` makes; recipes with the same data share one corpus

depot.description: the depot's address: a folder or a bucket; empty until a person names it, and the check names each recipe to fill in

dataset.description: the name of a dataset of that depot; empty until a person names it, and the check names each recipe to fill in

tokenizer.description: a file name in data/recipes/tokenizers/, without .json

model.description: the architecture's numbers (docs/model.md; wpt_model.ModelConfig without vocab_size, which the tokenizer gives, and block_size, the last window length of the steps' text windows)

window_layers.description: window layers on each side of the exact layer of the first half

sparse_groups.description: groups of the second half, each one exact layer followed by sparse_layers sparse layers

sparse_layers.description: sparse layers of each group; the model has 2 x window_layers + 1 + sparse_groups x (1 + sparse_layers) layers

attention_heads.description: query heads of every attention layer and of the multi-token prediction block

attention_head_dim.description: each query head and the one key-value head; a window layer rotates its last 64 dimensions

top_k.description: routed experts per token, fewer than n_experts

expert_width.description: hidden width of a routed expert

latent_width.description: width of the space routed experts work in

shared_width.description: hidden width of each of the 2 shared experts

engram_layers.description: layers (numbered from 1) that get Engram memory

engram_order.description: largest N-gram; orders 2 .. N are read

engram_table_size.description: each table has a distinct prime size, the smallest at or above this

residual_groups.description: groups of consecutive sublayers (each layer's attention, then its experts) whose outputs Attention Residuals sums into one source; at most 2 x the layers, which is the full form, every sublayer's output a source of its own

loops.description: extra passes of the text through every layer with the same weights (docs/model.md, "Loops"); 0: one pass, nothing of the loop in the weights or the cost

seed.description: the initial weights and every step's draws (text windows, the order of conversations and tasks, the tools offered, the sampled tokens) come from it, each step mixing its number in the list into it, and every step's fingerprint names it (docs/training.md, "Steps")

steps.description: what is done to the model, in order, by one wpt train run (docs/training.md, "Steps"); the model's context is the last window length of the last step that reads text windows

step.description: a built-in step of wpt_training (read-text, answer-as-assistant, finish-tasks, finish-tasks-with-less-writing) or a .py file

optimizer.description: the optimizer the step's loss moves the weights with; left out, the step's own

name.description: a built-in optimizer of wpt_training (by-part) or a .py file

settings.description: its settings; those left out keep the step's defaults for its own optimizer, else the optimizer's
the step's settings (those of its method and environment among them); those left out keep the step's defaults

locked.description: the parts of the model the step leaves unchanged, by the names docs/model.md, "Parts", gives (an unknown name is refused); left out, the step's own

continues.description: true: the step goes on from the whole state the step before it left (its weights, the optimizer's, method's and environment's state, its count of updates) and draws as it does, as one step stopped and resumed; it has the same step, method, environment, optimizer and locked parts, and more updates (docs/training.md, "Continued steps"); left out, false: it starts from the weights alone

drafter.description: the drafter wpt train trains at the end of every run, after the last step (docs/model.md, "The drafter"; wpt_inference.drafting); a setting left out keeps its default

features.description: the model layers whose hidden states the drafter reads, numbered from 1 to the model's last layer (a run refuses another before it trains); default: wpt_model.drafter.feature_layers

markov_rank.description: rank of the Markov head; default 256 x d_model / 4096

warm_up.description: share of the updates the learning rate rises over

anchors.description: anchors drawn from each answer per epoch

prompts.description: training documents whose beginnings are prompts

prompt_tokens.description: the most tokens of a document's beginning in its prompt

answer_tokens.description: the most tokens of each answer the model writes

held_out.description: share of the prompts kept apart for calibration and the measure
